num_tasks: <int> Number of tasks to be assigned and sequenced across the assembly line stations.
cycle_time: <int> Upper bound on the maximum total time any single station may use in one production cycle.
num_stations: <int> Number of stations on the assembly line to which tasks must be assigned.
processing_times: <list[int], length num_tasks> Time required to perform each task.
precedence_relations: <list[list[int]], length num_precedence_relations> Pairs [i, j] indicating that task i must be assigned to the same or an earlier station than task j, and must precede task j in sequence if on the same station.
forward_setup_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_tasks][num_tasks]> Time to transition from task i to task j when they are processed consecutively within the same station during a single production cycle.
backward_setup_times: <list[list[int]], shape [num_tasks][num_tasks]> Time to transition from the last task processed on a station in one cycle to the first task on that same station in the next cycle.
